title: Optimal spectrum estimation
summary: We prove that the spectrum of an unknown $d$-dimensional quantum state can be estimated to error $\varepsilon$ in total variation distance using \[ O\!\left(d^2\min\left\{ \frac{1}{(\varepsilon\log d)^4},\; \frac{1}{(\varepsilon\log d)^2} \right\}\right) \] copies. This matches the recent lower bound of Wang. When restricted to unentangled measurements, we give an algorithm with an additional factor of $d$ in copy complexity, which we conjecture to be optimal.
